sentences.Michelle åpner, og Elias, sønnen til nab: Michelle opens the door, and Elias, the neighbour's son, is standing outside.
sentences.Hjelp! Pappa ligger på gulvet!: Help! Dad is lying on the floor!
sentences.Michelle løper ned trappa til 3. etasje: Michelle runs down the stairs to the 3rd floor and into the neighbour's flat.
Gaute is lying on the floor. He is quiet.
sentences.Michelle bøyer seg ned og klapper ham fo: Michelle bends down and pats him gently on the cheek.
sentences.Ja, det er meg. Har du skadet deg?: Yes, it's me. Have you hurt yourself?
sentences.Ja, det gjør vondt. Jeg tror jeg har bru: Yes, it hurts. I think I've broken my arm.
sentences.Ligg stille. Jeg skal undersøke deg litt: Lie still. I'll examine you a bit.
sentences.Du har slått deg kraftig. Vi ringer ette: You've had a bad fall. We'll call an ambulance.
sentences.Jeg har så mye å gjøre. Jeg må male ferd: I have so much to do. I have to finish painting the ceiling, and Elias can't be alone.
sentences.Ikke tenk på det! Vi skal hjelpe deg. El: Don't think about that! We'll help you. Elias can stay with us.
sentences.Ambulansen har kjørt Gaute til sykehuset: The ambulance has taken Gaute to hospital.
sentences.Nå ligger han der med brudd i armen og s: Now he's lying there with a broken arm and shoulder.
sentences.Gaute har hjulpet dem mange ganger, og h: Gaute has helped them many times, and he has also encouraged Paul to apply for new jobs.
Now Paul can help his neighbour a little.
sentences.Han har malt ferdig taket hans, og Elias: He has finished painting his ceiling, and Elias has moved into Ben's room.
sentences.Der hører de på musikk og spiller datasp: There they listen to music and play computer games.
